description: email.rs handle_email_set() and submission.rs handle_submission_set(): non-string values in the destroy array are silently skipped (id_val.as_str() returns None → continue). RFC 8620 §5.3 defines destroy as Id[] — non-string elements are malformed. Trigger: client sends {"destroy": ["validId", 42]}. Bad behavior: the integer 42 is silently skipped with no error entry in notDestroyed; the client gets no indication the non-string entry was invalid. Should return a notDestroyed entry for the malformed entry or reject the request with invalidArguments.
title: destroy array: non-string elements silently skipped instead of reporting invalidArguments
